disposition_reasons.D225: Selftest uses finally cleanup/disposal, bounded termination and process exit wait; launcher runspaces live in the child process and it creates no descendants.
disposition_reasons.D226: Sensitive preparation output persists only SHA/length metadata and no raw bytes.
disposition_reasons.D227: Session member authority is published only after watcher Thread.start succeeds; startup failure closes the inherited descriptor without retaining active state.
disposition_reasons.D228: Session owner independently attempts all handle releases and child cleanup, clears current authority despite cleanup errors, and member revocation always reaches os._exit even if POSIX group termination raises.
disposition_reasons.D229: Setup timeout becomes a controlled error, diagnostics redact secrets, and main execution subtracts elapsed setup time from the outer budget.
disposition_reasons.D230: Slots declaring source identities require a source adapter before execution.
disposition_reasons.D231: Snapshot rejects symlinks and paths resolving outside the workspace; separate diff-read check prevents later link replacement.
disposition_reasons.D232: Source patch anchor uniqueness counts overlapping occurrences.
disposition_reasons.D233: SourceBridge rejects whitespace/control and path separator characters in policy IDs.
disposition_reasons.D234: Strict artifact verification handles json, text and python-ast and fails unknown kinds.
disposition_reasons.D235: Structured sensitive keys redact their entire values; keys themselves are text-redacted.
disposition_reasons.D236: Submission failure disposes worker/runspace/cancellation state and clears async references.
disposition_reasons.D237: Task factory rejects empty expected set, omitted supplied paths and expected artifacts that cannot pass their own finite checks.
disposition_reasons.D238: Task factory rejects unknown kinds and overrides for unregistered expected paths.
disposition_reasons.D239: Task, snapshot, Git receipt and inline verification each reuse one read for parse and hash.
disposition_reasons.D240: The design notice has no contract requiring a schema_version. Adding one would invalidate pinned historical bytes without repairing a demonstrated consumer.
disposition_reasons.D241: The persisted stop_after boundary is checked before entering another iteration.
disposition_reasons.D242: Timeout diagnostic uses the actual resolved task timeout.
disposition_reasons.D243: Token Plan rejection asserts no mock transport call.
disposition_reasons.D244: Tool binding compares full executable/host/Git identity on every profile before cache lookup.
disposition_reasons.D245: Tool campaign terminal checkpoint acquires summary/gates before publication; terminal resume repairs missing summary without dispatch.
disposition_reasons.D246: Tool campaign validates task plan mapping/key; context campaign requires decoded plan object.
disposition_reasons.D247: Transport checks argv[0] by resolved identity and preserves actual supplied argv.
disposition_reasons.D248: Transport module import does not execute cli_transport.py; install verifies registered source hashes before load_profile executes it. Owner-invoked trusted preparation remains a separate documented checkout trust boundary.
disposition_reasons.D249: Transport receipt normalizes None/str captures to bytes before hashes, retaining the completed process result.
disposition_reasons.D250: Transport result nested receipt/quality/artifact maps are validated and malformed containers produce ValueError at the handled boundary.
disposition_reasons.D251: Unknown targets and all no-op mutants fail explicitly.
disposition_reasons.D252: Unknown-tool rejection has an explicit one-call counter.
disposition_reasons.D253: Usage-file parse/type errors retain a dictionary and structured invalid-usage flag without losing other execution evidence.
disposition_reasons.D254: Usage/diagnostic JSONL readers ignore nonobject events and malformed item/usage blocks.
disposition_reasons.D255: V1 adoption validates carried Git policy, reporting types and transient state before merge; merged V2 binding is validated before any managed-state write.
disposition_reasons.D256: Validator import checks loader, registers its module and reports missing/unloadable runtime clearly.
disposition_reasons.D257: Wall-time source preparation measurement was removed from the hashed protocol, retained in separate preparation receipt.
disposition_reasons.D258: Windows guard identity normalization translates extended UNC prefixes to ordinary UNC paths before comparison. Native UNC normalization has a mocked Win32 API regression; no network-share I/O is claimed.
disposition_reasons.D259: Worker callback and parent call handlers catch Exception; KeyboardInterrupt propagates after durable fencing/cleanup.
disposition_reasons.D260: Worker messages are checked as finite JSON before appending any value to durable observations.
disposition_reasons.D261: Worker task_sha256/task_phases maps must contain exactly registered task_order IDs before callback dispatch.
disposition_reasons.D262: Workflow begin requires capture.ok before persisting its active-workflow/Git start snapshot; failure retains the prior binding.
disposition_reasons.D263: Writer checks the legacy lock again after acquiring the native guard, closes that guard and retries if the legacy owner appeared.
disposition_reasons.D264: actor_id must be one bounded [A-Za-z0-9_-] path component before constructing per-actor paths.
disposition_reasons.D265: checks_passed surfaces only after an accepted known EXECUTED receipt; rejected/infrastructure evidence remains None.
disposition_reasons.D266: execute_batch rechecks reparse ancestors at actual write boundary and requires explicit project_root; broker passes real root, artifacts must remain outside it.
disposition_reasons.D267: execution_guidance must be a list of group objects, including explicit null/string baseline input.
disposition_reasons.D268: load_callable converts missing attributes to ValueError before CLI error reporting.
disposition_reasons.D269: materialize checks candidate/model and theta container type before length/index operations.
disposition_reasons.D270: materialize validates policy object, nonempty ID, supported severity and list fields before sorting.
disposition_reasons.D271: paired no longer registers --backend; argparse rejects the unused option.
disposition_reasons.D272: reflect rejects nonfinite input immediately and handles large finite integer modulo without float overflow.
disposition_reasons.D273: run_parser is selected explicitly through commands.choices after parser creation.
disposition_reasons.D274: scope_ok is false whenever submission parsing/shape/duplicates invalidate the response.
disposition_reasons.D275: source_digest deliberately binds all canonical source-tree bytes except bytecode/cache artifacts. An unexpected source-tree file must trigger drift rather than silently changing the attested source namespace; no real production corruption was demonstrated by the report's editor-file example.
disposition_reasons.D276: trusted_arm_models validates statement and string policy_ids list before downstream access.
disposition_reasons.D277: validate_report rejects nonobject JSON payloads before metadata/dict/get operations, producing a controlled ValueError.
disposition_reasons.D278: validate_resume requires trusted_checkpoint_sha256 from an independent caller-owned registration; provider run_actor accepts trusted_resume_sha256. Self-contained hashes alone no longer admit.
disposition_reasons.D279: write_evidence records ok and only confirmed changed paths; rejected patch paths are empty.
